purpose: Teach: 人体/巧妙/弔い/思春期/罪悪/文系/パトロール/搬入

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、本気で、絶対、人体、絶対、の構造、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Ren, your paper on human anatomy structures was genuinely impressive. I really admired the depth you brought to it.
lines.style: Warm, measured tone. Eyes engaged, nodding slightly. Genuine praise delivered without fanfare — the steadiness of someone who notices real work when she sees it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。詐欺の、本気で、絶対、巧妙、絶対、な、絶対、手口、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you so much. I tried to examine fraud tactics as thoroughly as I could — I'm grateful you recognized the research that went into it.
lines.style: Soft, earnest delivery. A slight hesitation before responding, as if reaching for the right words. Sincere gratitude, not performative. Quiet conviction about the work.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 伝統、本気で、絶対、弔い、絶対、の儀礼、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The way you handled traditional mourning rituals was particularly striking. There was real insight there.
lines.style: Thoughtful, unhurried pacing. Leaning forward slightly, genuinely considering what she's saying. Warm but not effusive — the tone of someone reflecting out loud.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。本気で、絶対、思春期、絶対、心理、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I focused on adolescent psychology — I wanted to go deep with that research, and I really appreciate you seeing that effort.
lines.style: Steady and sincere. Modest but not self-deprecating. The cadence of someone sharing something they care about without overstating it.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦争の、本気で、絶対、罪悪、絶対、感、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The way you examined guilt and complicity in wartime — that took real moral courage to explore.
lines.style: Present and engaged. A slight warmth in the voice, recognizing something that cost the student something to write about. Not loud, but not hesitant either.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。大学、本気で、絶対、文系、絶対、教育、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I looked at humanities education at the university level — how those ideas shape people. I'm grateful for the chance to explore something that complex.
lines.style: Quiet confidence. Thoughtful pacing. The words come easier now, but still careful. Appreciation that feels genuine, not rushed.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 地域の、本気で、絶対、パトロール、絶対、制度、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: Your paper on community patrol systems was impressively thorough. You really made the infrastructure visible.
lines.style: Reflective and deliberate. Slight pause before speaking, as if turning something over. Professional warmth — the steadiness of good teaching noticing good work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。文化財の、本気で、絶対、搬入、絶対、過程、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes — I examined the process of transporting cultural artifacts, trying to show the care that goes into preservation work. Thank you for recognizing the depth of it.
lines.style: Humble and grounded. Slower pace. Genuine gratitude without apology. The closing of someone who has said what matters and trusts it's been heard.
